control: Unmodified upstream Stage 2 server on SDK 0.9.0; E154 is a separate decode-control port
scope: Whole prompt execution and request scheduling, followed by layer-wise batched projection and FFN integration
actual_call_path: src/api/worker.rs constructs host::worker::Worker; src/api remains unchanged
Generation owns all prompt token IDs, per-position soft-token descriptors, and each request's image/audio data
Worker asks Generation for up to 16 consecutive prompt positions or exactly one autoregressive decode position
Worker allocates full-attention Blocks through the last position of the chunk; sliding ring remains request-owned
Model::forward_sequences computes each request's complete sequence and returns one logits buffer per request
Generation::advance_inputs advances only actually computed positions and samples only at the final prompt/decode position

first_variant.name: serial-chunk-control
first_variant.kernel_change: None; sequences execute the original token-wise Model::step in position order
first_variant.removed_work: Per-position worker iteration, batch-vector construction, and admission-loop overhead within one prompt chunk
first_variant.added_work: Explicit borrowed input vectors and sequence validation
first_variant.performance_claim: None. This is a correctness-preserving integration interface, not the batched compute implementation.

batched_execution_graph: Prepare row-major bf16 activations [B=16,H=3840] from text embeddings or original per-request image/audio encoders
For each decoder layer: row-wise input RMS, joint Q/K/V projections, original head normalization and RoPE
Causal attention with request-specific positions and Blocks, then joint O projection, post-attention RMS and residual
Row-wise pre-FFN RMS, joint up/gate projection and GeGLU, joint down projection, post-FFN RMS, residual and layer gate
Repeat through all 48 layers; compute logits only for the final prompt row when requested

ownership_and_storage.weights: Model-owned read-only HBM tensors shared across requests as model parameters
ownership_and_storage.activations: Bounded B16 HBM scratch; no activations or encoder outputs reused between requests
ownership_and_storage.full_kv: Workspace pool; physical page IDs from each Sequence.blocks, allocated through chunk end
ownership_and_storage.sliding_kv: One ring per active request; a later chunk row must not overwrite history needed by an earlier query
ownership_and_storage.sliding_initial_fallback: Commit row KV and evaluate that row's attention before committing the next row
ownership_and_storage.sliding_batched_target: Keep current-chunk K/V separate from the old ring, attend causally, then commit the chunk
ownership_and_storage.media: Input.soft retains exact original token index and borrows only the owning request's media

invariants: No dependence on ignore_eos or other accuracy/performance classification
No cross-request KV or encoder-output reuse
Only final sequence input may request logits; every earlier input still updates its causal computation
Decode always consumes one previously sampled token
Full attention page and sliding ring boundaries preserve original semantics
Errors restore the workspace/logits ownership swap before propagating
Prompt chunks stop at full-cache page boundaries so every live row visits the same full-attention pages.
validation: Host compile and sequence boundary/state tests
Serial-chunk control versus upstream outputs for text, image, and audio
Chunk lengths 1,15,16,17 and boundaries around full page 512 and sliding ring 1024
Batched projected values and final logits versus the serial control on identical inputs
Full mixed public workload TTFT, TPOT and generated tokens/s on NPU before any speed claim
next_decision: After the serial interface compiles, integrate one compiled batched FFN/projection primitive; a backend failure selects a concrete mapping/API repair rather than a parameter sweep. Root owns NPU jobs and official submissions.
